card.name: Digits inside numbers and names
card.fires_on: A digit partway through a decimal coordinate or section number, or a piece in the middle of a foreign personal name. It is mostly in numbered cross-references and coordinates.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal coordinate, a section cross-reference or a page range.

modes.label: Inside foreign surnames
modes.description: A middle piece of a less common personal name, often after a title or first name.
modes.example: Dr Heriberto<< P>>imiento Patino, director of Santa Mat

card.writes: No clear output effect; it mildly promotes non-English tokens, mostly Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a number or a section reference, and on the middle of an unusual personal name.
